title: Whispering Gardens

[[image:Whispering Gardens.jpg|thumb|Whispering Gardens]]
The '''Whispering Gardens''' are located in northeastern [[Tirisfal Glades]], on the hill south of the [[Scarlet Monastery]]. A great battle was fought here between the what would become the [[Scarlet Crusade]] and a host of [[Scourge]]. The spirits of those fallen in battle can still be heard here as faint whispers in the twilight.
